svg.text: Character sheet · draft 3 · a 12-issue comic for the SMART Study newsletter
Five pupils, one school dog, and the longest lunch break in history.
Soft, organic shapes. No outlines, no geometry.
Limited risograph palette on warm paper, with a light grain.
Dark ink only for faces and small details.
Text in Atkinson Hyperlegible, made for readability.
Same uniform; props tell them apart.
